display_long_description:
# Media View brings all digital media into mixed reality.

We are building a streamlined utility to let you step out of the confines of a traditional screen and view your content using the space around you.

**Please note: Media View is in active development. Critical updates are coming soon.**

What it does today:

- Multi-Panel Workspace: View multiple (currently limited to 3) 2D photos, panoramas, and 360° videos simultaneously around your space. 

- Immersive Mode: Instantly toggle from your multi-panel layout to step inside 360° and panoramic content with full room-scale immersion.

**Known Issues & What’s Next:**

We hear the community: getting your own custom content into the app is currently frustrating. We are actively rebuilding the file upload workflow. Please be patient with us as we iron out these bugs and push critical updates over the coming weeks.

We are building this tool for the VR community, and your input drives our roadmap. To submit feature requests, report bugs, or connect with our team, please visit: mediaviewxr.com
